claimBoundary: Each listed proof board was opened individually at original detail. This review records visible defects and limitations but does not substitute for Adam's taste approval or runtime admission.

reviews.finding: All six states read at proof and play scale. Resting is clearly seated; rear view is a true back construction. The rear gauntlet and sword grip show no obvious malformed hand or broken contact in this return. Identity and taste still require Adam.
The material remains coherent across island, hole, donut, L, mirrored L, neck, stair, diagonal, snake, and seeded-field topology proofs; no clipped transition is visible.

The slate courses remain aligned and seamless in the 4x4 torus. Adjacency-aware deterministic selection removes the earlier obvious six-variant diagonal cadence while preserving all six source variants.
Chest, shrine, and barrel are isolated and grounded. Foreign chest/barrel fragments present in the real source exports are absent after audited zero-gap cleanup.
Source, aged, and aged-wet states remain registered and materially coherent. The state strength is intentionally subtle; whether it is strong enough for gameplay remains a taste/readability decision.
The harmonized fighter preserves silhouette, value hierarchy, and protected visual roles. The change is modest because the source already fits the target fantasy palette.
Decorative caps remain intact at 260, 500, and 900 pixels; only the declared center span changes. The 40-pixel delivery height remains exact.

All six crack families remain intact through four rotations with no nominal-cell clipping or chroma fringe. The real decals are deliberately low-contrast; final scene readability remains surface-dependent.
The fighter keeps its source silhouette, receives a clear safe border and foot baseline, and remains legible on the six-foot play-scale card.
The cleaned barrel, chest, and shrine round-trip visibly intact in the packed atlas with transparent separation and no neighboring-sheet debris.

Height, normal, roughness, and black emissive channels are coherent with the real floor albedo and satisfy the technical channel contract. They remain machine-derived proposals, not approved authored material maps.
Identical real floor inputs produce a visibly black difference panel and pass the zero-difference budget.
The changed aged-wet real floor produces a strong visible RGB difference and is correctly rejected by the zero-difference gate.
